title: A hidden entity picking recruits from the GATE pool
summary: Jordan tells of A hidden entity picking recruits from the GATE pool, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: different entity that is utilizing Gate behind the scenes to find a pre-selected pool of people and pull them into the programs

plain: A man who goes by Jordan told podcast host Jesse Michels that he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child. He says a hidden group, separate from the public one, works behind the scenes of GATE, a US school programme for gifted and talented children, to find people it has already picked out and pull them into secret programmes. If true, it would mean bright children are being quietly scouted for this work.
